event_description: Captures when a search query is submitted or executed, with query terms, results count, courses count, and sort order.
Captures when a user opens a search result card (video moment or lesson topic) with result type and start seconds.
Captures search result clicks for backward compatibility with existing insights.
Captures when the search results sort order dropdown is changed.
Captures when a user clears their active search query.
Captures when a lesson video starts playing with provider type, title, and initial timestamp.
Captures when playback crosses 25%, 50%, 75%, 90%, and 100% completion milestones.
Captures when a learner starts or resumes video playback from a non-zero timestamp.
Captures when a video playback is paused with current time and progress percentage.
Captures when a learner marks a lesson as complete, finishes the video, or advances to the next lesson.
Captures when a learner completes the final lesson or whole course.
Captures when a user navigates to and views a lesson page.
Captures when a user bookmarks or unbookmarks a lesson.
Captures when a user switches between the Lesson Content and Notes tabs.
Captures when a user clicks an external lesson resource or document link.
Captures when a user navigates using Previous Lesson or Next Lesson buttons.
Captures when a user clicks on a course card from the catalog or home page.
Captures when a user bookmarks or unbookmarks a course.
Captures when a user clicks the Continue Learning CTA in the course hero or floating progress bar.
Captures when a user expands a course curriculum module accordion.
Captures when a user toggles the full course curriculum accordion list.
Captures when a category filter pill is selected in the course catalog.
Captures when an experience level filter is selected in the course catalog.
Captures when all catalog filters are reset.
Captures when a user clicks the Explore Courses button in the homepage hero.
